title: Inappropriate Fallback State Grants Admin Privilege on Auth Error
description: Defaults user role to 'admin' when permissions lookup service times out or errors.

ground_truth.description: Inappropriate fallback behavior: defaults to administrative privilege when permission service fails.
ground_truth.explanation: Violates fail-secure principle (CWE-1188); system must fail closed (guest/unauthenticated) rather than open (admin).

expected_evidence.description: Fail-open privilege escalation in error recovery path.
